regime.label: Protection bid rebuilt into a +13.6 rally, with spot 12 points under a gamma flip that keeps sliding toward it
evidence: Put OI +1,612 in one session against call OI -205 — 1010 puts +329 on 552 lots, 1050 puts +278 on 452, 910 puts +1,001 on 1,015 — insurance bought while the index rose 1.27%.
Net dealer GEX is only +5,939 baht per index point (calls +22,978, puts -17,039) on 49,769 total OI — too thin in either direction to call the book decisively long or short gamma.

Gamma flip interpolates to 1097.2 versus spot 1085.2: the 12.0-point gap is the tightest of the 8-session window (36.9 points on Aug 5), leaving spot inside the short-gamma pocket that runs 1030-1097.
ATM IV 12.50% is the window low, -1.12 points since Aug 10, while the index printed a 1.59-sigma day against an 8.55-point daily sigma — realised is running above implied.

S50U26.today_summary: S50U26 closed the future at 1085.2, +13.6 (1.59 sigma), the first close of the window above the 2,303-OI 1080 call wall. The stack above spot was bought back rather than defended: 1100 call OI -198 on 312 lots, 1080 -61 on 210, 1110 -43 on 265. Against that, put OI grew +1,612 with the heaviest builds at 1010 (+329), 1050 (+278) and a 910 tail hedge (+1,001 on 1,015 lots at 23.98% IV), lifting PC OI to a window-high 1.84 and PC volume to 2.07 on an up day. Max pain has not moved off 1070 in eight sessions and at 43 DTE exerts no pinning force.
what_changed: Spot +13.6 to 1085.2 — a 1.59-sigma session and the first close above the 1080 call wall in the 8-session window.
Call OI above spot decayed on heavy volume — 1100 -198 (312 lots), 1080 -61 (210), 1110 -43 (265) — resistance bought back into the breakout instead of reloaded.
Put OI +1,612 versus call OI -205 in one session, pushing PC OI 1.73 to 1.84 and PC volume 0.85 to 2.07 while the index rallied.
ATM IV -0.47 to 12.50% (window low) and 25d skew collapsed from +1.80 on Aug 13 to +0.12, even as the 10d tail held +2.62.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Max pain has been frozen at 1070 for all eight sessions while the anchor travelled 1081.7 to 1071.7 to 1085.2, so the pin has done no work and is not the story. Since Aug 10 put OI added +2,608 against +645 of call OI — 910 +1,608, 1010 +380, 1050 +341 — which is what carried PC OI from 1.75 to a window-high 1.84. The gamma flip has walked down from 1112.9 (Aug 5) to 1097.2 today while spot rose 9.2 points, compressing the spot-to-flip gap from 36.9 points to 12.0, the tightest reading of the window. No GEX sign flip occurred: net gamma stayed marginally positive throughout (+2,823 to +5,939 baht per point), which is why this is a Protection build and not a dealer regime change. ATM IV compressed 13.62% to 12.50% and the 25d band narrowed from 1040-1120 (80 points) to 1050-1110 (60 points) even as price rose, so the market is paying less for a cone it keeps buying insurance inside.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050 / 1010
strategies.rationale: Buys the same two strikes the market itself funded today — 1050 puts +278 OI on 452 lots, 1010 puts +329 on 552 — inside the 1030-1097 short-gamma pocket where dealer re-hedging amplifies a decline rather than fading it, at a 12.50% ATM IV that is the window low.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit of about 5.5 points (1050 put 8.7 mid less 1010 put 3.2 mid). Max gain 34.5 points at 1010 or below; breakeven 1044.5.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1100 — the 2,101-OI near call wall and the 1097.2 gamma flip. Above it the book turns long gamma and the amplification pocket loses its trigger.

strategies.name: Long strangle 1110 call / 1050 put
strategies.rationale: ATM IV at 12.50% is the window low while today printed 1.59 sigma, so implied is under-pricing what the index is delivering; the 25d band has narrowed to 60 points even as the 10d tail stays +2.62 put-rich, which is where a long-vol structure gets paid if either wing prices in.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = premium paid, about 17.75 points (1110 call 9.05 mid + 1050 put 8.7 mid). Breakevens 1127.75 and 1032.25, both inside the 46.8-point sigma over the remaining ~30 trading sessions.
strategies.invalidation: Price holding the 1050-1110 25d band for the next 10 sessions with ATM IV under 12.5% — theta bleed with no realised move is the losing path, not a price break.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1090 / 1110
strategies.rationale: Expresses the breakout above the dissolving 1080 wall without paying for upside the structure will not give: the 1100-1150 shelf carries 8,355 call OI and sits above the flip where dealers turn long gamma and dampen, so the payoff is deliberately capped at 1110.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit of about 7.5 points (1090 call 16.55 mid less 1110 call 9.05 mid). Max gain 12.5 points at 1110 or above; breakeven 1097.5, effectively the gamma flip.
strategies.invalidation: A close back below 1080 — the call wall that just gave way turning back into resistance marks a failed breakout.

S50U26.prediction: Base case is a 1070-1100 grind: 1σ is only 8.55 points a day, max pain sits at 1070, and the 1100-1150 shelf holds 8,355 call OI above a 1097.2 flip that dampens rallies once cleared. The asymmetry is downward — a slip back under 1080 re-enters the short-gamma pocket where cumulative GEX troughs at -4,200 around 1050-1070, and 1050 is now the live put support with 1,598 OI on 452 lots. A close above 1100 on expanding call volume invalidates that skew and shifts the structure long-gamma and range-bound higher.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only — not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat max pain at 1070 as a tendency, not a magnet, especially at 43 DTE where gamma is far from its expiry spike. The 910 put wall's 12,319 OI is a 16%-OTM tail hedge, not near-money support — it inflates the 1.84 PC OI ratio and the +2.62 10d skew and should not be read as a bearish vote. Defined risk is not risk-free; the stated max loss on each structure is a real outcome, and macro or news flow can override the option structure outright.
